passage: Amber and her father went on a winter rafting trip. They packed up their car and drove to the river. The staff at the riverside shop gave them a map and some very helpful tips. “The water will be cold and fast, so you better hold on,” they said.

They entered the rapids. Amber gripped her paddle and asked her father to do the same. She did not want to tip over or go under the water. Amber saw some litter. “We better pick up the litter,” she said.
At the end of the river, Amber and her father docked their raft on the riverbank. Together they walked back to the car and had some snacks.
